content.text:
I fixed the bug: each page now includes its last item. All 9 tests pass, including 3 new ones.

**Cause:** in `/work/notes-api/src/utils/paginate.js`, the page's end position was set to `start + size - 1`. But `Array.prototype.slice(start, end)` already leaves out the item at `end`, so subtracting 1 dropped one more item from every page. A page of size 20 returned only 19 notes, and the missing note didn't show up on any page.

**Fix:**
```js
const end = start + size; // slice() end is exclusive
```
`pageCount` and the `GET /notes` route in `/work/notes-api/src/routes/notes.js` were already correct, so I didn't change them.

**New tests** in `/work/notes-api/tests/paginate.test.js`:
- Full pages contain every item: `paginate([a,b,c,d], 2, 2)` returns `[c, d]`, as the function's own doc comment says.
- The last page returns whatever items are left, even if it's not full.
- Going through every page returns each item exactly once.

The old tests didn't catch this because they only checked the first item of a page and the empty page past the end.

I didn't change how bad `page` or `size` values are handled, such as `0`, negative numbers or non-numbers. That's outside this fix.
